label: Declared-association per-query processing bound on generated legal CLI fixtures
runner: omp-worker on the same shared worker host, fresh per-observation SQLite store copied from each case's closed synced store
fixture: measure.py generates eight case corpora and declaration files; passage-v1 sync; default 1 MiB per-file and 64 MiB total CLI limits; query alpha, 4096-byte budget except the no-budget control; 5 observations per ordinary case and 3 per large/many-tiny case
limitations: The pre-bound uncommitted source snapshot is not archived with this result; its surviving binary hash and raw observations identify that measured run. The bounded snapshot is product_base plus the recorded uncommitted diff. Shared-host wall timings are descriptive, not an isolated latency comparison. Canonical record content is bounded per query; sync/indexing cost for a 65536-passage item is not eliminated.
